tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag gsal bar bkod pa chos kyi rnam grangs legs par rtogs byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag gsal bar bkod pa chos kyi rnam grangs legs par rtogs byed ces bya ba// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam par mi rtog 'dod nas lhun grub ye sangs rgyas// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug che de mtshan dpe'i lang tsho ci yang ngom// ā di'i bu dang sbyin skyes mes po dga' byed bde 'byung legs skyes sogs// cher rloms kun gyis phyag byas de la rnam pa kun tu bdag phyag 'tshal// bsam rtog gnyis med gnyen po'i mchog /gang zhig chags bral zhi ba che// 'gog dang lam gyis rab bsdus pa'i// dam pa'i chos la rtag phyag 'tshal// ji lta ji snyed nang gi ye shes 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs shing*// 'gro kun bdag med gnyis kyi mtha' ni yang dag rab rtogs gzigs pa rnam dag yul mnga' ba// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes zhugs rab mthong sgrib spangs mtha' yas don rab rtogs pa rgyal ba'i sras// brtul zhugs dbang dang rten 'brel sgom sogs rtog ge'i lam spangs mi ldog tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rmongs mun gyur pa mtha' dag kun// skad cig zos pas khyod kyi sku// nyi ma lta bur gzi 'bar ba| |'jam mgon khyod zhabs spyi bor bteg /gdod nas yongs grub gzugs dang bral yang mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar kun tu snang*// grags stong sgra dbyangs brjod las 'das kyang drang nges chos sgra rgyun mi 'chad// zab gsal ye shes spros pas dben yang gang 'dul sprul pa cir yang ston// mi 'phrog dpa' bo 'jam dbyangs gzhon nus bdag blo'i snang ba rgyas par mdzod// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// ye shes gcig tu bsdoms pa'i gzugs| |'gro blor snang ba gang gi mtshan// mgon po 'bri gung pa der 'dud// rab yangs rnam dpyod phrag gong mthug por lhag bsam dag pa'i 'dren byed kyis// bka' dang bstan bcos legs bshad kun gyi khur rnams bzlums te rab khyer bas// khyod rnams ngal zhing dub par srid snyam bdag gi spyi gtsug 'dab brgya bas// lo paṇa skyes mchog sngar byon rnams kyi zhabs sor 'degs shing sbyor la brtson| |'dir gang bshad par bya na/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse ba can/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des legs par gsungs pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi rnam grangs gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur 'tshal phal che ba phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa la bka' 'gyur zhes grags pa de nyid la chos kyi rnam grangs ji tsam bzhugs pa'o// de la gsum/ phan yon ji lta bu mthong nas bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bzhengs pa de dag la chos kyi rnam grangs ji tsam zhig bzhugs pa'i grangs nges/ de dag bzhengs pa'i phan yon ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul lo// dang po phan yon ji lta bu mthong ba dang*/ bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ thog mar 'dul ba'i sde snod ni/ 'dul ba'i mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu// 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas dang*// nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bstod| |ces dang*/ ji skad du/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas ston pa so sor thar pa la chol/ zhes sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs shing ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu nyid kyis bka' gnang ba'i phyir dang*// mdo sde'i sde snod ni ji skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing*/ rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ na bza' dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang*/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur sti bya/ bla mar bya/ ri mor bya/ mchod par bya/ brjod par bya/ gsol bar bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i gdams ngag go// zhes dang de nyid las/ kun dga' bo da lta nga bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sku 'di la khyod kyis dga' ba dang dad pa dang*/ ri mor byas pa de bzhin du| nga 'das kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la yang rim 'gro byos shig /kun dga' bo ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nub par mi 'gyur zhing*/

ci nas kyang khyod skyes bu tha mal par mi 'gyur bar khyod la lan gsum du yongs su gtad do// rjes su gtad do// kun dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par rigs par bya'o// kun dga' bo de srid du de bzhin gshegs pas chos ston par rigs par bya'o// kun dga' bo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid nyan pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kun chub par bya ba dang*/ rab tu 'don pa dang*/ lung nod pa dang*/ ston pa dang*/ kha ton du byed pa dang*/ 'bri ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ na bza' dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang*/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur stir byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed/ brjod par byed/ gsol bar byed pa'i sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ma bral ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang ma bral ba dang*/ dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang ma bral bar rigs par bya'o// kun dga' bo sems can de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung na spyod pa rigs par bya'o// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las/ gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur pa// bde bar gshegs pa'i yum 'di glegs bam la bris te// 'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na// mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod// ces sogs phan yon brjod kyis mi lang bar gsungs so// rdo rje theg pa'i phan yon ni dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi nang gi le'ur/ 'khor bar mi nyid du ni 'gyur ba dag kyang 'ga' zhig dub ste chos kyi blo ni res 'ga' na// de bas sangs rgyas la ni rjes chags dge ba'i dbang gis 'gyur zhing dang po'i theg par rab tu 'jug

/de bas dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa la ni blo gros ma lus rgya lam dag na 'jug /de las sangs rgyas nyid 'dod mchog gi bde ba'i go 'phang dag la 'jug pa e ma shin tu dka'// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ste// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste| |zhes sogs gsang sngags 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas mthong ba las kyang ches dka' ba dang*/ bstan pa 'di nyid la ma gtogs bstan pa gzhan la 'byung dka' ba sogs phan yon dang rnyed par dka' tshul ches mang ba gsungs la/ gzhan yang 'di skad ces smra ste/ kye ma da lta dal 'byor lus// dka' ba'i gnas 'di thob dus su// dge ba'i las la 'bad rigs kyi| |de yi dge ba gang zhe na// brtags shing dpyad de 'bad par bya// khengs grags rnyed brtson la bsam zhing*// chags dang sdang bas mtshams sbyar bas// dge ba'i las kun ltar snang nyid// 'gro mang ngal bar bya ba yi// gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi sogs// dge ltar snang yang sdig pa'i rgyu// rgyags dang 'thab pa'i dmigs 'dun gyis// khyim pa'i mkhar rdzong ltar bcos pa'i// dgon gnas rnams kyang ming snyan tsam// bslab gsum yon tan rgyang bsrings nas// dmar ser lwa ba'i rdzu bag gis// 'dus par rlom pa rnams la yang*| |bsnyen bkur 'bras bu chu shing 'dra// dge ba gyi na'i 'bras bu yis// dang po cung zad dang ldan yang*// lhag bsam med pa la sbyin pa// bsod nams ci 'dra e ma nongs| |de phyir ltar snang dge ba'i tshogs// spyad pas byang chub thob sems pa// zla ba'i 'od kyi pad+mo'i tshal// 'dzum par byed rlom 'khrul spangs nas// rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa'i chos// ngan slad dri mas ma gos pa// dpyad gsum dag pa 'di ko dag /kho bos lhag bsam dag pas bzhengs// zhes tshigs su bcad de smras so// gnyis pa bzhengs pa de dag la chos kyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa ni/

de yang tshul gsum sgron me las/ bden pa'i de nyid tshul mthong gang*// pha rol phyin pa'i tshul gang yin// de bzhin gsang sngags tshul lugs gang*// zhes rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa rnams rim can du gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang brjod par bya ste/ dang po 'khor lo thog ma bden bzhi'i chos kyi tshul 'dul ba'i sde snod la glegs bam bcu gsum bzhugs pa la/ (ka) dum par/ 'dul ba lung bzhi bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yan bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ 'dul ba lung bzhi bam po nyer lnga pa nas bam po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ 'dul ba lung bzhi bam po lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ 'dul ba lung bzhi bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa nas brgya dang dgu pa'i bar gyis rdzogs par bzhugs pa/ kha che'i mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ kha che'i mkhan po dharma ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur cing slar rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur zhus bgyis pa/ (ca) dum par/ dge slong pha'i so thar gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa dang*/ dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed kyi bam po nyer gcig pa yan bzhugs/ (cha) dum par/ pha'i rnam 'byed bam po nyer gnyis pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ja) dum par/ pha'i rnam 'byed bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa nas drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ (nya) dum par/ pha'i rnam 'byed bam po drug cu rtsa gsum pa nas brgyad cu rtsa gsum bar gyis rdzogs par bzhugs pa/ kha che'i mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab/ (ta) dum par/ dge slong ma'i so thar gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/

dzi na mi tra dang*/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba dang*/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed bam po nyer brgyad pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ dharma ka ra dang*/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing*/ slar mkhan po bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa bzhugs/ (tha) dum par/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi bam po nyer bdun pa yan bzhugs/ (da) dum par/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi bam po nyer brgyad pa nas lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i bar gyis rdzogs pa 'di la kha 'gengs kyang mang du mdzad dgos pa byung tshul 'dug pa rnams/ paṇ+ḍi ta bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ dharma shrī pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur zhus mdzad pa bzhugs/ (na) dum par/ 'dul ba gzhung bla ma zhes sam gzhung dam par grags pa chung ngu'am zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis pa dang*/ yang zhu ba ma rdzogs pa'i bam po nyer gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ (pa) dum par/ gzhung dam pa'i 'phro zhu ba rdzogs pa bam po nyer gsum pa nas lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i bar gyis rdzogs pa la 'gyur byang ma byung bas btsal dgos so// de'i mjug tu bzang spyod smon lam/ byams smon/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam rnams/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyal po gser gyi lag pas mdzad pa'i mar me'i smon lam/ gser 'od nas gsungs pa'i smon lam/ stong chen rab 'joms nas gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rma bya chen mo nas gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig /yangs pa'i grong khyer tu 'jug pa'i mdo/ bde legs kyi mdo tshigs bcad/ yang bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs bcad/ rgya cher rol ba'i mdo tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u las byung ba'i shis brjod/ dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas shis pa brjod pa/

bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis shis pa brjod pa/ lhas zhus pa'i shis brjod/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi shis brjod/ dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi shis brjod/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs so/// / ༈ /gnyis pa rgyu'i theg pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod| 'khor lo bar par gtogs pa la thog mar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa 'bum glegs bam bcu bzhi bzhugs pa las/ (ka) dum par/ bam po bcu dgu pa'i bar bzhugs| (kha) dum par/ rgyas pa 'bum gyi bam po nyi shu pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa nas drug cu rtsa gsum pa'i bar bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po drug cu rtsa bzhi pa nas brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ca) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgyad cu rtsa lnga nas brgya dang drug pa'i bar bzhugs/ (cha) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgya dang bdun pa nas brgya dang sum cu pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ja) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgya dang so gcig pa nas brgya dang nga gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ (nya) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgya dang nga gnyis pa nas brgya dang re dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/ (ta) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgya dang bdun cu pa nas brgya dang go gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ (tha) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po brgya dang go gsum pa nas nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi'i bar bzhugs/ (da) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po nyis brgya dang bco lnga pa nas nyis brgya dang so brgyad pa'i bar bzhugs/ (na) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po nyis brgya so dgu pa nas nyis brgya dang re gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ (pa) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po nyis brgya dang re gnyis pa nas nyis brgya dang gya gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ (pha) dum par/ 'bum gyi bam po nyis brgya dang gya gnyis pa nas bam po brgya dang gsum pa'i bar bzhugs pa la/

rtag ngu dang chos 'phags yongs gtad kyis kha bskangs te bzhugs pa la 'gyur byang med do/// / ༈ /sher phyin 'bring po stong phrag nyi shu lnga par glegs bam bzhi bzhugs pa las/ (ka) dum par/ le'u dang po nas bcu gcig pa'i stod yan bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ nyi khri le'u bcu gcig pa'i smad nas nyer bdun pa'i stod yan bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ nyi khri le'u nyer bdun pa'i 'phro nas le'u lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i stod yan bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ nyi khri le'u nga gsum pa'i 'phro nas le'u bdun cu rtsa lnga ste rdzogs par bzhugs pa la 'gyur byang ma byung bas brtag go/// / ༈ /sher phyin bsdus pa brgyad stong pa sde tshan rgyas pa bam po nyer bzhi pas rdzogs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya se na dang*/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba dharma shī las bsgyur ba'o// slar rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'grel pa dang bstun te bcos pa/ slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi rgya dpe dang bstun nas bcos shing*/ slad mar yang paṇa chen a ti sha nyid dang*/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis gtan la phab cing*/ yang 'brom ston gyis rwa sgreng du yang rgya dpe gsum dang bstun nas gtan la phab pa bzhugs so/// / ༈ /sher phyin 'bring po las cung zad bsdus pa khri brgyad stong pa dang shes rab khri pa bsdoms par glegs bam bzhi bzhugs pa las/ (ka) dum par/ khri brgyad stong pa'i bam po dang po nas nyer gnyis pa yan bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ khri brgyad stong pa bam po nyer gsum pa nas bam po zhe bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ khri brgyad stong pa bam po zhe lnga pa nas drug cu pa'i bar gyis rdzogs pa la 'gyur byang ma thebs pas btsal/ de'i mjug tu sher phyin bsdus pa khri brgyad stong pa las cung bsdus pa shes rab khri par grags pa'i bam po dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar bzhugs/

(nga) dum par/ shes rab khri pa'i bam po dgu pa nas sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar gyis tshang ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa'o/// / ༈ /(ka) dum par/ sher phyin sna tshogs pa'i skor bzhugs pa la/ 'phags pa sdud pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa rab rtsal rnam par gnon pas zhus pa/ sher phyin bstan pa bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos la/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ sher phyin lnga brgya pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ rdo rje gcod pa sher phyin lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams te sher phyin gyi tshan pa bcu gnyis/ mdo phyis 'gyur ba mdo mang du ma chud pa chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa sgom pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' brtul ba'i mdo/ 'od srung chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo rnams te/ de ltar mdo phran bcu gsum po/ paṇ+ḍi ta a nan+ta shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o/// / ༈ /bka' tha ma'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ snyan gong rgyan/ pad+ma'i spyan/ sangs rgyas rma ga chad/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang zhing rma ga chad ni brda rnying ste yang dag pa'i don yin la/ des na shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che las/

(ka) dum par/ phal po che bam po dang po nas sum cu pa'i bar bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ phal po che bam po so gcig pa nas drug cu rtsa gcig pa yan bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ phal po che bam po drug cu rtsa gnyis pa nas dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ phal po che bam po dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa nas brgya dang bco brgyad pa'i bar rdzogs par bzhugs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab ste/ 'di la chos kyi rnam grangs ni de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'u la bam po bcu bzhi/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba la bam po bcu gsum/ sa bcu bstan pa la bam po brgyad/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa la bam po bcu drug /de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa la bam po lnga/ 'jig rten las 'da' ba'i le'u la bam po bcu gcig |sdong po bkod pa la bam po sum cu zhes sho lo ka sum brgya re la bam por mdzad pa'i dbang gis te dkar chag rnying pa khungs thub rnams las gsungs so/// / ༈ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgyad pa las le'u bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bod du 'gyur ba la glegs bam drug bzhugs pa las/ (ka) dum par/ le'u dang po dkon mchog brtsegs pa sdom pa gsum bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos so// le'u gnyis pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par spyod pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po bcu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/

lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ le'u bzhi pa 'phags pa rmi lam bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang ma byung*/ le'u lnga pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ dkon mchog gi le'u drug pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod pa bam po lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u bdun pa 'phags pa go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa bam po drug pa 'gyur byang ma byung*/ le'u brgyad pa 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u dgu pa 'phags pa chos bcu pa bam po so gnyis pa lo paṇa snga ma de dag gis bsgyur ba/ le'u bcu pa 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u bam po gcig kho na lo paṇa snga ma de dag gis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa| le'u bcu gcig pa 'phags pa 'od zer kun nas bkye ba bstan pa bam po lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa/ le'u bcu gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa'i bam po dang po nas gsum yan bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ dkon brtsegs las byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi bam po bzhi pa nas nyi shu pa'i bar gyis rdzogs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra dang*/ shī len+d+ra dang*| dharma tā shī las bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos par le'u bcu gsum pa dga' bo mngal gnas bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang med pa/ le'u bcu bzhi pa 'phags pa dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ le'u bco lnga pa la 'jam dpal zhing gi bkod pa bam po bzhi pa/

paṇ+ḍi ta shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ dzi na mi tra/ lo tsā ba dz+nyā na de bas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ dkon brtsegs kyi le'u bcu drug pa yab sras mjal ba'i mdo bam po bco lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur nas zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ le'u bcu bdun pa gang pos zhus pa/ bam po drug pa 'gyur byang ma byung*/ le'u bco brgyad pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/ lo chen ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u bcu dgu pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ca) dum par/ dkon brtsegs kyi le'u nyi shu pa 'phags pa glog thob kyis zhus pa/ bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa/ le'u nyer gcig pa sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo chen ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ le'u nyer gnyis pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa/ lha'i bu ded dpon gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ lo paṇa snga ma rnams kyis bsgyur ba/ le'u nyer gsum pa byams pa seṅge sgra'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ lo paṇa snga ma de dag gis bsgyur ba/ le'u nyer bzhi pa 'phags pa 'dul ba rnam par gtan la dbab pa 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ lo paṇa snga ma kho na'i 'gyur byang*/ le'u nyer lnga pa 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba bam po gnyis pa/ lo paṇa gong dang 'dra ba/ le'u nyer drug pa 'phags pa lag bzang gis zhus pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/ lo chen ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u nyer bdun pa 'phags pa des pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/

paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ le'u nyer brgyad pa khyim bdag dpal byin gyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ le'u nyer dgu pa bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ lag bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo dang 'gyur 'dra/ le'u sum cu pa bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa bam po phyed pa/ des pas zhus pa dang 'gyur byang 'dra/ le'u so gcig pa 'phags pa gaṅgā'i mchog gis zhus pa dang*/ sho lo ka brgyad cu pa 'gyur byang dpal byin gyis zhus pa dang 'dra ba/ slar skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u so gnyis pa 'phags pa mya ngan med byin lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ des pas zhus pa dang 'gyur byang 'dra/ le'u so gsum pa 'phags pa dri ma med kyi byin pa lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang des pas zhus pa dang 'dra/ le'u so bzhi pa 'phags pa yon tan rin po che'i me tog kun tu rgyas pas zhus pa bam po phyed pa/ 'gyur byang sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa dang 'dra/ le'u so lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa dang 'dra ba/ slar skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u so drug pa lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa bam po gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs/ (cha) dum par/ dkon brtsegs kyi le'u so drug pa lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i bam po gsum pa nas bzhi pa yan chad rdzogs pa/ lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ le'u so bdun pa 'phags pa seṅges zhus pa sho lo ka drug cu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims sbyin pa dang*/ thub pa go cha dang*/ lo tsā ba pradz+nyā se nas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/

le'u so brgyad pa gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la dang*/ karma warma dang*/ lo chen ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u so dgu pa tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang des pas zhus pa dang 'dra/ le'u bzhi bcu pa bu mo rnam dag dang bas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang ma byung*/ le'u zhe gcig pa 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang des pas zhus pa dang 'dra| le'u zhe gnyis pa byams pas zhus pa chos brgyad bam po phyed pa/ 'gyur byang lag bzang gis zhus pa dang 'dra/ skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u zhe gsum pa 'phags pa 'od srung gis zhus pa lung bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims dbang po byang chub dang*/ rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u zhe bzhi pa 'phags pa rin po che'i phung po lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta lha dbang byang chub dang*/ lo tsā ba pradz+nyā se nas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ le'u zhe lnga pa 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'gyur byang rin po che'i phung po lung bstan pa dang 'dra/ le'u zhe drug pa sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa dang 'dra/ le'u zhe bdun pa 'phags pa gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ le'u zhe brgyad pa 'phags pa dpal phreng seṅge'i sgras bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur bcos mdzad pa/ le'u zhe dgu pa 'phags pa drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/

dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams bzhugs so/// / ༈ /bka' 'khor lo gsum pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'dres can du bzhugs par mdo mang zhes brjod pa la glegs bam so gnyis bzhugs pa las/ (ka) dum par/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyer drug pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba/ mkhan po dpal brtsegs kyis zhus shing gtan la phab pa bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco brgyad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par rol ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ sems can thams cad gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus par/ slar yang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtan la phab pa rnams te mdo tshan bzhi bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mthar phyin pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po nyer lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing*/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi shud+dha singha dang*/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus shing gtan la phab pa/

'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba ste mdo tshan gnyis bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ 'phags pa dge ba yongs su 'dzin pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bco brgyad pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos kyis bsgyur cing*/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā warma dang*/ dz+nyā na garbaha dang*/ ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs bam po bzhi pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka nyis brgya bdun cu pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad ces pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka drug cu pa/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan lnga bzhugs/ (ca) dum par/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa laṅkar gshegs pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po dgu pa rgya gar nas bsgyur pa dang*/ 'phags pa laṅkar gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po bam po brgyad pa/ rgya nag gi mkhan po wen hīs mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang sbyar ba ste 'gos chos 'grub kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ga ya mgo ri zhes pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa ste mdo tshan bzhi bzhugs/ mdo phyi ma la skad dod ga ya shīr+ṣa zhes pa bod skad kyi skabs ga ya legs sbyar sor bzhag la shīr+ṣa mgo zhes bsgyur ba la deng sang gsung rab la lar ga ya go ri zhes 'byung ba ma dag go//

(cha) dum par/ 'phags pa rgyan stug po bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po theg chen gyi mdo bam po drug pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*| ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa snying rje pad+ma dkar po theg chen gyi mdo bam po bco lnga pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa rnams te mdo tshan gsum bzhugs/ (ja) dum par/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po theg chen gyi mdo bam po bcu gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po theg chen gyi mdo/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka sum brgya pa gnyis/ ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa za ma tog bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ dkon mchog gi za ma tog bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa gnyis/ lo tsā ba rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa rin po che'i mtha' zhes pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya bcu gnyis pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde la sogs kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa ste mdo tshan bzhi bzhugs/ (nya) dum par/ 'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo rgya nag 'gyur gyi bam po nyer brgyad pa yan bzhugs/ (ta) dum par/ myang 'das rgya nag 'gyur gyi 'phro bam po nyer dgu nas lnga bcu rtsa drug gi bar tshang bar bzhugs pa/ rgya nag gi mkhan po waṃ pham dang*/ dge ba'i blo gros dang*/ rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ (tha) dum par/ 'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po theg chen gyi mdo le'u nyi khri lnga stong pa las lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i bam po bcu gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/

dz+nyā na garbaha dang*/ lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo chung ba/ ka ma la gup+ta dang*/ lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge bam po bzhi pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ban+de ye shes sdes skad gsar bcad kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po gser gyi mdo dang*/ 'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes pa theg chen gyi mdo gnyis/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba ste mdo tshan bdun bzhugs/ (da) dum par/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco lnga pa/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba dharma shī las bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcas kyis gtan la phab pa/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo stong nyid las mi g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad snang ba'i mdo theg chen sho lo ka dgu bcu pa/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa dang*/ 'phags pa rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po phyed gnyis| su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang med pa| 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams te/

mdo tshan drug bzhugs/ (na) dum par/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyi 'gyur la skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi yi ge theg chen bam po gnyis pa/ rgya nag 'gyur/ 'phags pa khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po mchog dam pa bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs theg chen gyi mdo bam po brgyad pa/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying po'i gzungs theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sho lo ka bco brgyad pa/ 'gyur byang med pa rnams te mdo tshan dgu bzhugs/ (pa) dum par/ 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs sho lo ka nyer gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sde la sogs kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo le'u bcu pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/

ye shes sde la sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa bam po bdun pa/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po brgyad pa/ bi dza ya shī la dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa| 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa chos bdun pa theg chen gyi mdo/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur te mdo tshan dgu bzhugs/ (pha) dum par/ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bcu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ bud+dha pra bha dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo 'bring po theg chen dge bcu bshad pa sho lo ka nyis brgya dang*/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu pa gnyis/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka stong nyis brgya yod pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sde dang*/ yi ge pa dgon gling rma la sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/

lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan drug bzhugs/ (ba) dum par/ 'phags pa tshangs pas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo/ sho lo ka nyis brgya pa/ dzi na mi tra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po drug pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ dharma pā la dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba dharma tā shī la dang*/ de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi ta dang*/ ku mā ra shī la rnams kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dpal dbyig gis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka sum brgya dang drug cu pa/ dz+nyā na garbaha dang*/ ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ 'phags pa rin chen zla bas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya rtsa bdun pa/ bi shud+dha singha dang*/ dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ slad kyi bid+yā ka rasingha dang*/ lha'i zla bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bde byed kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu pa/ bi shud+dha singha dang dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ slad kyi bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ lha'i zla bas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bde byed kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa gsum/

'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa rnam par 'phrul pa rgyal pos zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag bam po bzhi pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*| dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka dgu bcu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa bsgres mos zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya bco lnga pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan bcu bzhi bzhugs/ (ma) dum par/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka dgu bcu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa bdag med pas dris pa theg chen gyi mdo/ ka ma la gup+ta dang*/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa dang*/ 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug pa gnyis/ chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka phyed dang bco lnga pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dz+nyā na singha dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/

'gyur byang med pa rnams te mdo tshan dgu bzhugs/ (tsa) dum par/ phar phyin lnga bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po drug pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka drug brgya pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa sho lo ka sum cu pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya nyi shu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ ye shes snying po dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ 'di phal po che'i dum bur snang ste mjug tu snyan gyi gong rgyan zhes bris snang bas so// 'phags pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya bcu pa/ bi shud+dha singha dang*/ dge ba dpal dang*/ dz+nyā na garbaha dang*/ nā ga dh+wa dzas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bzhi bcu pa/ bi shud+dha singha dang*/ dge ba dpal dang*/ bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ lha'i zla bas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa/ 'phags pa bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig lhag pa gnyis/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa lha mo dpal lung bstan pa sho lo ka brgya pa/

'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gnas pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu pa/ su ren+d+ra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa bdud rtsir brjod pa theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa rgyal ba 'jug pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka drug brgya pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ bid+yā ka ra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su mthun par 'jug pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya dang bcu gcig pa/ dā' na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams te mdo tshan dgu bzhugs/ (tsha) dum par/ 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya theg chen gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa nges pa dang ma nges pa 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa chos kyi phyag rgya theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa mar me phul ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya pa/ pradz+nyā garbaha dang*/ klu'i dbang po dang*/ bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ de ba tsan+d+ras bsgyur ba/ zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka so brgyad pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ glang po'i rtsal zhes bya ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sgra chen po theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/

bi shud+dha sidha dang*/ dge ba dpal dang*/ slar yang bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ rba rje ye shes snying po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sa lu ljang pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya nyer drug pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang*/ rnam par dbye ba bstan pa theg pa thun mong ba'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu gsum pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ dharma tā shī la dang*/ rgya nag gi lo tsā ba tong ā tsār+ya sogs kyis bsgyur/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa theg chen gyi mdo/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa theg chen gyi mdo/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur/ 'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī garbaha dang*/ ā tsār+ya rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dpal sbas kyis zhus pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa theg chen gyi mdo/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya sum cu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams te mdo tshan nyi shu tham pa bzhugs/ (dza) dum par/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/

dharma shrī pra bha dang*/ dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka drug cu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa rnga bo che'i theg chen gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyi 'gyur| 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba theg chen gyi mdo/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa srid pa 'pho ba theg chen gyi mdo/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rnam par thar pa thams cad sdud pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bgro ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ dz+nyā na garbaha dang*/ dpal dbyangs dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'dus pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan bcu gcig bzhugs/ (wa) dum par/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin bam po bdun pa/ rin chen 'tsho dang*/ chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sprin chen po theg chen gyi mdo bam po bcu pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba sho lo ka stong phrag brgya nyi shu pa/

lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po theg chen gyi mdo/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sprin chen po las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u zhes bya ba drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba sgrub pa'i don mngon par mthong ba'i rgyud/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa bsdus pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ gtsug tor chen po bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nyi tshe byung ba sho lo ka sum brgya tsam yod pa/ rgya nag 'gyur rnams te mdo tshan bdun bzhugs/ (zha) dum par/ 'phags pa chos yang dag pa sdud pa zhes sam bgro ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ mañdzu shrī garbaha dang*/ bi dza ya shī la dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bcu pa| rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang zab mo la sogs pa dang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de rnam par mi rtog pas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo theg chen gyi mdo bam po drug pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ mu ni warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo theg chen gyi mdo/ li'i dge slong shī la dharma dang*/ rnam par mi rtog gis bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan lnga bzhugs/

(za) dum par/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal po theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi tshul theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa chos kyi phung po theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka dgu bcu go gnyis pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gsum gyis bsgyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i chos bzhi sgrub pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ dge slong shākya blo gros dang*/ dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu gsum pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo sho lo ka bcu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi sgrub pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ chos gsum pa'i mdo/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ lha'i zla bas bsgyur cing*/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ chos kyi rgya mtsho theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu pa/ chos kyi rgya mtsho sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnad bshad pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po bam po bcu gsum pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ dharma ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba bzang skyong rnams kyis bsgyur cing*/

dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo theg chen bam po gcig pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig lhag pa/ shākya pra bha dang*/ rin chen 'tshos bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa thabs mkhas pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa rnams te mdo tshan dgu bzhugs/ ('a) dum par/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa bam po brgyad pa/ 'gyur byang med pa| 'phags pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gi 'dul ba'i bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po bcu gcig pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ 'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyis sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gnyis pa dang*/ sho lo ka brgya dang bcu gnyis pa/ rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang*/ mtshan nas brjod pa'i yon tan gyi gleng gzhi dang*/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan dang mdo sde bcu gnyis dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang bshags pa'i le'u rnams 'byung ba'i nye tshe ba/ bcos shing bsgyur ba 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa me tog gi tshogs theg chen gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi dang*/ dharma tā shī la sogs kyis bsgyur ba rnams te mdo tshan lnga bzhugs| (ya) dum par/ spang skong phyag rgya pa/ li the si'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba theg chen gyi mdo bam po phyed/

bi shud+dha singha dang*/ rtsangs de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing*/ klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhus chen bgyis pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya dang lnga pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu pa theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gcig pa theg chen gyi mdo/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas dbu rgyan theg chen gyi mdo chos kyi rnam grangs chen mo sho lo ka brgya lhag pa/ shākya singha dang*/ ban+de de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi theg chen gy-i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ban+de ye shes sdes ṭī ka bzhi dang bstun nas gsar du bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas mi spong ba theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka brgya nyi shu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra/ 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa theg chen gyi mdo sho lo ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang*/ chos rjes su dran pa dang*/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa rnams kyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ sku gsum pa theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ phung po gsum pa theg chen gyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka nyis brgya sum cu pa/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/

bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing*/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus chen bgyis pa/ theg pa chung ngu'i mdo tshan bzhugs pa la/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bam po nyi shu tham pa yan chad rnams te mdo tshan bcu dgu bzhugs/ (ra) dum par/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi bam po nyer gcig pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa yan chad bzhugs/ (la) dum par/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi bam po bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa nas mu su lun+dha'i rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes bya ba yongs rdzogs bsngo zhes pa'i bar bzhugs/ (sha) dum par/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi 'phro gzhan yang las dang 'bras bu'i rnam par smin pa shes pa'i dge slong de mtshe ma rnams la phan pa'i don du zhes pa nas dran pa nyer bzhag yongs su rdzogs pa/ lnga brgya pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shan+tā ka ra gup+ta dang*/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta dang*/ bid+yā ka ra shan+ta sogs kyis rgya dpe lnga dang*/ shākya rak+ṣi ta dang*/ bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra sogs kyis rgya dpe gnyis la nyan bshad zhus te lo tsā ba pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slad kyi zhang bu gcig pa shes rab 'od kyis grogs byas te lo tsā ba shī la dh+wa dza nyid kyis zhus dag legs par mdzad pa yin la/ dkar chag snga ma rnams su dran pa nyer bzhag theg chung du bshad mod kyang mdo 'di ga'i tshig gi don dang*/ 'gyur byang la brtag na theg chen kho na yin zhes lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bzhed par mngon no zhes zhwa dmar pa bzhi pa dharma kīrti dz+nyā na shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i dkar chag tu gsungs pa nyid don la gnas par mngon no// gzhan yang theg chung gi mdo bzhugs pa la/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba bam po gcig lhag pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba bam po phyed pa dang*/

mdo chen po stong pa nyid sho lo ka dgu bcu pa dang*/ mdo chen stong pa nyid chen po bam po phyed pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog rnams/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradz+nyā warma dang*/ ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa sho lo ka bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa sho lo ka nyis brgya bzhi bcu pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gsum gyis bsgyur pa/ 'phags pa rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ gzhon nu dpe'i mdo/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ khams mang po'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya/ 'gyur byang med pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i mdo/ dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ dge slong rin chen bzang pos gtan la phab pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo rnams te mdo tshan bcu bzhi bzhugs/ (sa) dum par/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo bam por ma phye ba/ ā tsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo/ ā tsār+ya dz+nyā na shrī gup+ta dang*/ shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ mchog tu gdams pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ tshe mtha'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa/ bi shud+dha sidha dang*/ dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur cing*/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang dpal brtsegs kyis zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ tshe 'phos pa ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo sho lo ka bco lnga pa/

su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo snga ma dang 'dra min/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka bcu gcig pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ mtshan ma bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo sho lo ka lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa| 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ mun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ pha ma'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ bden pa bzhi'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ don rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ don rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka brgya pa/ mjug ma tshang ba/ rmad du byung ba'i mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs pa'i phan yon yang dag par brjod pa sho lo ka drug cu pa/ dharmā ka ra dang*/ ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing*/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus chen bgyis pa/ mchod rten skor ba'i tshigs bcad/ 'gyur byang med pa/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa'i sho lo ka brgya pa rnams la/ 'gyur byang med pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom bam po bzhi pa/ dgra bcom pa chos skyabs kyis bsdus pa/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang*/ rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing*/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ skyes bu dam pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya pa/ dharmā ka ra dang*/ bzang skyong gis bsgyur cing*/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo sho lo ka lnga bcu pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ lha'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu sho lo ka brgyad cu bdun pa/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

zla ba'i mdo sho lo ka bcu gsum/ 'gyur byang med pa/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo sho lo ka drug cu pa/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ gnas 'jog gi mdo sho lo ka nyi shu pa/ sarba dz+nyā na de ba dang*/ dpal brtsegs sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ dga' ba can gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya pa/ 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i mdo dang kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga gnyis bsdoms par bam po gcig /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo las rnam par 'byed pa'i bam po gnyis zer ba dkar chag tu snang yang gsung rab nang du bam po gnyis zer ba mi snang la sho lo ka drug brgya cung zad med pa 'dra zhig 'gyur byang med pa/ las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba chos kyi gzhung bam po gcig 'gyur byang med pa rnams te mdo tshan so brgyad bzhugs/ (ha) dum par/ mdo sde las brgya pa'i stod cha bam po nyer dgu pa dang*/ sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun yan chad bzhugs/ (a) dum par/ las brgya pa'i 'phro bam po nyer dgu pa sdom tshig brgyad pa man chad nas bam po sum cu rtsa bdun pa dang*/ sdom tshig gi bcu pa yan gyis yongs su rdzogs pa 'gyur byang med pa/ mdzangs blun zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bcu gnyis pa/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ mauṅgal gyi bus ma dmyal khams nas drangs pa bam po gcig pa/ kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa'i mdo chos kyi rgyal po bam po gnyis pa rnams la/ 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta a nan ta shrī dang*/ sa skya pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ byams pa lung bstan pa sho lo ka brgya pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ gnas brtan spyan drangs pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'jam dpal khye'u bzang theg chen gyi mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa'i rnam par smin pa lci yang bstan pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ gzhon nu bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ da dung 'gyur bcos dgos pa rnams te mdo tshan bcu gcig bzhugs/

(ki) dum par/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po nyer gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ de ba tsan+d+ra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo sho lo ka bco lnga pa/ bid+yā ka ra singha dang*/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa sho lo ka brgya pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing*/ rin chen bzang pos zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams mdo tshan bzhi bzhugs/ (ku) dum par/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ zla 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa gnyis pa| dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ shes rab legs pas bsgyur cing*/ rin chen bzang pos zhus pa/ gser mdog sngon gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba 'phags pa rgyal po don grub kyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ tshangs pa dra ba'i mdo rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/ thabs la mkhas pa drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa theg chen gyi mdo/ lo tsā ba chos 'grub kyis rgya gar nag gnyis kyi dpe las bsgyur ba/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshul lung bstan pa/ 'phags pa glang ru lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa rnams/ 'gyur byang med pa/ stag sna'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ shākya yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ mig bcu gnyis pa'i mdo/ 'gyur byang med pa/ sme bdun zhes pa skar ma'i mdo/ lo tsā ba ma hā pā la dang*/ shrī a nan ta badz+ras rgya nag yu gur hor gyi yi ge las bsgyur ba/

thub pa chen po drang srong a gasta'i rnam pa bstan pa le'u bco lnga pa/ ār+ya byā ka ra ṇa'i nang nas byung ba gza' dang sgyu skar gyi rang bzhin bshad pa dang*/ zla ba'i khyim rtsi ba dang*/ sgyu skar rtsi ba'i cho ga mdo sde las byung ba bsdus pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa rnams te mdo tshan bcu bdun bzhugs so// de dag la dran pa nyer bzhag dang*/ 'jam dpal khye'u bzang ldan dang*/ legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo rnams ma gtogs/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba zhes pa nas zla ba'i khyim rtsi ba dang*/ rgyu skar rtsi ba'i cho ga mdo sde nas byung ba zhes bya ba'i bar gyi theg chung gi mdo 'di rnams 'khor lo dang po'i khongs su gtogs pa yin mod kyang*/ sngon gyi lo paṇa chen po rnams kyis mdo sde sna tshogs bzhugs pa la mdo mang zhes grags pa 'di dag gi khongs su bzhugs 'dug pa ltar 'dir yang de ltar bgyis pa yin no/// / ༈ /gsum pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi tshul bshad pa la'ang gnyis te/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur dang snga 'gyur du grags pa'o// dang po gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gsar mar grags ba la glegs bam bco brgyad bzhugs la/ bla med rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ bya rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhir grags pa'i dang po bla med la yang*/ gnyis med rgyud/ ma rgyud/ pha rgyud gsum las/ dang po gnyis med rgyud ni/ (ka) dum par/ 'phags pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba stong phrag bcu drug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dra ba'i le'u las byung ba bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ lo tsā ba chen po blo gros brtan pa gnyis pas bsgyur ba/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po dang*/ lo tsā ba 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing*/

slar yang rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel pa dang mthun par bcos pa/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud le'u lnga pa/ so ma nā tha dang*/ 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing*/ slar yang zhang ston mdo sde dpal dang*/ tshul khrims dar gyis tshig don gyi cha la dpyad cing*/ lo tsā ba shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis yul dbus kyi rgya dpe gnyis dang bstun te bsgyur zhus gtan la phab cing*/ slad mar yang blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ blo gros dpal bzang pos 'grel pa rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag bgyis pa/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po| gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po/ shrī bha dra bo dhi dang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang*/ phyis 'bro dge slong gis bsgyur ba/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ sa man+ta shrī dang*/ rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba rnams so// gnyis pa ma rgyud la rigs bdun te/ rigs drug mnyam par rtogs pa'i rigs/ he ru ka'i rigs/ rnam snang gi rigs| pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs/ rta mchog gi rigs/ rdo rje 'chang gi rigs dang bdun las/ dang po rigs mnyam par ston pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog rtsa rgyud brtag pa bcu dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma khri drug stong rtog pa brgyad cu bdun pa'i nang nas rtog pa bco brgyad pa nas nyer gnyis pa'i bar du dum bur gyur pa| smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrtis bsgyur ba/ gnyis pa he ru ka'i rigs la/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud kyi skor la rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i brtag pa dang po la le'u bcu gcig dang*/ brtag pa phyi ma le'u bcu gnyis pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing*/ slar yang gzhon nu dpal gyis 'gyur chad bsabs shing dag par bgyis pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje zab chen zhes sam/

rdo rje gur zhes bya ba le'u bco lnga pa lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ rgyud phyi ma phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud le'u nyer brgyad pa/ shes rab gsang ba dang*/ kaṃ chos kyi ye shes dang*/ phyug mtshams dgra bcom gyis bsgyur ba rnams te rgyud tshan bcu bzhugs/ (kha) dum par/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma dpal ye shes snying po le'u bzhi pa/ shes rab gsang ba'i rang 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud ye shes thig le le'u sum cu pa/ shes rab gsang bas bsgyur ba/ 'bras bu'i rgyud dpal kho na nyid kyi sgron me/ paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyis bsgyur ba rnams so// 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud kyi skor la/ bde mchog nyung ngu'am bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig sho lo ka stong bdun brgya pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pad+mā ka ra dang*/ rin chen bzang pos kha che'i dpe las bsgyur cing*/ slar yang pradz+nyā kīrti dang*/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis dag par bgyis pa/ de'i thun mong ma yin ba'i bshad rgyud kyi skor la mngon par brjod pa rgyud bla ma'i le'u drug cu rtsa dgu pa/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing*/ phyis dz+nyā na shrī dang*/ khyung po chos kyi blo gros kyis zhus shing*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da dang*/ lo chung gis chad lhag bsabs shing dag par bcos pa/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rim par phye ba lnga bcu pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis rgya dpe gnyis bstun nas bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bzhi bcu pa/ mchog gi dbang phyug dang*/ shākya brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur ba rnams te rgyud tshan bdun bzhugs/ (ga) dum par/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ dza ya se na dang*/ dharma yon tan gyis bsgyur cing*/ dpal mchog dang po'i sdes zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud rim par phye ba so gsum/

gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas dang*/ ru ban+de smon lam grags kyis bsgyur cing*/ slar yang shrī mān rat+na'i rgya dpe la bstun te gzhon nu dpal gyis dag par bcos pa/ khrag 'thung mngon par byung ba le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa ā dwa ya badz+ra dang*/ chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur ba/ de'i bshad rgyud phag mo mngon par byang chub pa/ dz+nyā nā ka ra dang*/ khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba/ rnal 'byor ma kun tu spyod pa le'u bcu bdun pa 'gyur byang ma thebs kyang 'dir mar do'i 'gyur yin zhes zhwa dmar pa bzhi pas gsungs so// rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor brtag pa bdun pa la chings yon tan 'bar gyis paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis la gtugs nas bsgyur ba/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba ral pa gyen brdzes las byung ba rig pa 'dzin ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ dza ya se na dang*/ dharma gu ṇas bsgyur ba/ bde dgyes thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud dpal yang dag par sbyor ba brtag pa bcu pa/ brtag pa re re la rab byed bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ slar yang bu ston rin chen grub kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor khongs bsabs shing legs par bcos pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba'i thig le zhes pa/ kā ya s+tha pa ga ya dha ra dang*/ shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ slad nas rgya dpe bzhi la gtugs nas shākya ye shes kyis legs par bcos pa rnams te rgyud tshan dgu bzhugs/ (nga) dum par/ ma rgyud skor gyi 'phros pa'i rgyud du gtogs pa tsam gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ rat+na badz+ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud rnams/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud/ rin chen rdo rje dang*/

'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dam tshig chen po'i rgyud/ stobs po che'i rgyud le'u lnga pa rnams/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud/ ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud/ ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud rnams/ rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra ma le dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ zla ba'i phreng ba'i rgyud/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma zla ba'i phreng ba dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i rgyud/ ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud/ gsang ba me 'bar gyi rgyud/ gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud rnams/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rgyal po'i rgyud/ tsan+d+ra ma le dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ chags pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud/ zla ba'i phreng ba dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro ma sdom pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud/ me'i phreng ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje grub pa dra ba sdom pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ stobs chen ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud/ dur khrod rgyan rmad du byung ba'i rgyud/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud rnams/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ de rnams la ā ra li'i rgyud so gnyis zhes grags so// bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ kha che dz+nyā na badz+ras rang 'gyur mdzad pa/ 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i thig le dang bstun nas dag par byas pa/ bde mchog dang phag mo gnyis ka'i bshad rgyud/ thun mong ba 'phros pa'i rgyud phag mo mngon 'byung le'u bcu pa de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u gnyis pa rnams/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/ mgon po gsang ba mngon byung gi rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra gup+ta dang*/

khye'u rgang 'khor lo grags kyis bsgyur cing*/ slar yang rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa'i spyan sngar kre bo shes rab dpal gyis zhus shing dag par bgyis pa/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa le'u bcu bzhi pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/ sgyu 'phrul chen po le'u gsum pa/ dzi na pa ra dang*/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje ā ra li le'u bcu pa/ ri ṣi ā ra li le'u lnga pa gnyis/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ rnam snang gi rigs rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud bdag gzhan sbyor gsang gi gdan re re la rim par phye ba bzhi bzhi yod pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba/ gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud sngags kyi cha'i rgyud le'u bdun pa lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba/ gdan bzhi'i rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud le'u mang du grags pa yin la/ 'di la dpal gsang ba thams cad kyi rgyud ces bya ba/ rnal 'byor thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud ces kyang grags pa ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrtis gsar du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ slad nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam rgyud 'bum la gtugs te zhus dag bgyis pa yin la rgyud 'di la le'u brgya dang bzhi yod do// dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa rnams/ rat+na shrī dang*/ yar klung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams te rgyud tshan bzhi bzhi bzhugs/ (ca) dum par/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ a tu la da sa badz+ra dang*/ mar pa chos dbang gis bsgyur ba/ mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud le'u lnga pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud sde le'u lnga pa/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs| rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs/ pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po nas byung ba rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa le'u gsum pa/

bi ma la shrī dang*/ shud ske grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i rtogs pa lnga pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ rta mchog gi rigs sgrol ma mngon 'byung gi rgyud le'u lnga brgya bdun cu pa nas phyung ba phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bstod pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa dum slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rgya dpe dngos las sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa/ sa man+ta shrī dang*/ rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'chang gi rigs ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u lnga pa rak+ṣa ga ga na dang*/ ma 'ongs byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur ba rnams so| |gsum pa pha rgyud kyi skor la mi bskyod pa'i rigs/ rnam snang gi rigs/ rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rigs/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs/ don yod grub pa'i rigs/ rdo rje 'chang gi rigs dang drug las/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur ba/ slar paṇa chen nyi ma'i dbang po dang*/ chag lo chos rje dpal gyis zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ su dza na shrī dz+nyāk+s+yan dang*/ lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa le'u bcu gnyis pa/ dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ dz+nyā nā ka ra dang*/ khug dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba/ slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/

nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa le'u bzhi pa/ smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur| dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud le'u bcu drug pa/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta dang*/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rab tu byed pa zhe gcig pa/ nā ro pa'i slob ma kha che a ka ra sid+dhi dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus pa/ dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud dpa' bo gcig pa rim par phye ba nyer lnga pa/ rat+na shrī dang*/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ slar paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang*/ gzhon nu dpal gyis zhus shing gtan la phab ste rgyud 'di rgyud 'bum nga dum pa'i mjug tu yod pa dang gnyis 'gyur bcos kyis 'dra min cung zad 'dug cing*/ 'di nyid ma rgyud rnam snang gi rigs yin pas gdan bzhi'i mjug tsam du sgrig dgos kyang 'gyur bcos phyis mdzad pas 'di'i zhabs su bsgrigs 'dug go// de nas dum pa 'dir rgyud tshan bcu dgu bzhugs/ (cha) dum par/ 'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba le'u nyer gnyis pa rgya dpe ma tshang bas dbu hor khongs su lus pa bu ston rin chen grub kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje dpal mchog chen po zhes grags pa/ mtshan gzhan gnyis med rnam par rgyal ba chen mo ste le'u bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas nub phyogs au ḍi yā na'i gtsug lag khang nas spyan drangs pa/ nub du la k+ṣe tra'i grong khyer chen por rgya gar gyi mkhan po grub mchog brnyes pa dpal ye shes snying po dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan dam pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje mi'i rnam par sprul pa/ lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis legs par bsgyur cing zhus te/

nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa yin la/ yang rgyud 'di la paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrtis rang bsgyur mdzad pa zhig yod par grags so// phyogs mthun gyi rgyud 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can drag po gsum 'dul/ de ba puṇ+ya ma ti dang*/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i rgyud rnams kyi rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba le'u gsum pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba| lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ 'gyur byang med pa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud las khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u| a ḍa ya shrī ma ti dang*/ chos kyi dbang phyug grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud le'u nyer bzhi pa dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u brgyad pa rnams/ a bhi yuk+ta dang*/ chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur ba/ rmi lam mthong ba'i gzungs rnams te rgyud tshan bcu bzhugs/ (ja) dum par/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ rat+na kīrti dang*/ dge tshul khyung grags kyis rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs nas bsgyur ba/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ wa la tsan+d+ra dang*/ dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud le'u nyer gcig pa/ lo paṇa snga ma gnyis kyis sham+bha la'i dpe dang bstun nas bsgyur cing*/ slad rgya gar nas yul dbus kyi dpe dang kha che'i dpe la gtugs nas bcos pa/ rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ska lcog gis bsgyur cing*/ phyis gnyan lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rdo rje bde khros kyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/

dz+nyā nā ka ras bsgyur ba/ rnam snang gi rigs la rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba rim par phye ba le'u bcu pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhes bya ba dgra nag gi rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ slad nas dar ma grags kyis bcos shing*/ de las kyang rdo rje grags kyis bcos pa/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor los las thams cad sgrub par byed pa zhes bya ba gdong drug gi rgyud dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa bha ro phyag rdum dang*/ lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po rim par phye ba bzhi pa/ a mo gha'i zhabs nus pa can dang*/ mar pa chos dbang grags pas bsgyur ba/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa/ la li ta badz+ras rgyud 'bum nas phyung ba/ dī paṃ ka ra dang*/ rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur cing*/ slad nas ut+ta ma shrī mi tra dang*/ rong zom chos bzang gis zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po rim par phye ba le'u bcu pa/ tsan+d+ra shrī'i zhal snga nas zhus shing*| tsan+d+ra kīrti dang*/ yar klung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur ba/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u nyer gnyis pa/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin chen grub kyis bsgyur ba/ pad+ma'i rigs dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/
